# Sui Kit — Sui DeepBook V3 Bot Kit

> A source-available development kit for building trading bots on DeepBook V3,
> the native liquidity layer of the Sui blockchain. $100 USDC one-time purchase,
> delivered as read access to a private GitHub repository.

## What it is

- Execution infrastructure for DeepBook V3: BalanceManager lifecycle, atomic
  cancel+place orders, MoveAbort code 3 mitigation, gas-reserve logic
- Deterministic 5-phase quant decision layer (optional LLM overlay)
- Ops tooling: live dashboard, Telegram alerts & control, fill detection,
  cost-basis tracking, error/stagnation monitoring
- Sold as source code + documentation. Not a profit machine, not a signal
  service, not a managed product.

## Why it exists

AI codegen can draft a bot in a weekend, but months of on-chain debugging —
locked balances, abort codes, stale prices, gas edge cases — is what turns a
draft into something that survives live markets. This kit is that time already
spent: feed the repo to an AI agent and it builds on working, commented
reference code instead of guesses.

- Price: $100 USDC (early access; regular price $199 planned)
- Delivery: private GitHub repo invite after on-chain payment verification
- License: personal use; redistribution/resale prohibited

- Independence: not affiliated with, endorsed, or sponsored by Mysten Labs
  or the Sui Foundation
- Contact: Telegram bot @sui_kit_bot · contact@suikit.dev
